description: This file implements the Singleton pattern for managing a list of singleton instances within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes methods for registering, unregistering, disposing, and accessing the singleton list, along with destructor logic to ensure proper cleanup.

classes.name: Singleton::SingletonList
classes.description: Manages a list of singleton instances, providing registration, unregistration, disposal, and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: Singleton::ListInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton list instance, ensuring a single static list is used throughout the application.

methods.name: Singleton::SingletonList::~SingletonList
methods.description: Destructor that checks if the singleton list is empty and calls Dispose to clean up remaining singletons.

methods.name: Singleton::SingletonList::Dispose
methods.description: Deletes all singleton instances in the list.

methods.name: Singleton::SingletonList::Register
methods.description: Adds a singleton instance to the list.

methods.name: Singleton::SingletonList::Unregister
methods.description: Removes a singleton instance from the list.
